dialogues.speaker: Manaia
dialogues.text: You can't just drink this water whenever you want! It doesn't matter if you're a Saurian, or very good at swimming!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hot spring water's not suitable for drinking.

dialogues.speaker: Manaia
dialogues.text: I recorded my experiences here and sent them back by mail. In his reply, Monsieur Neuvillette urged me to wait for the hot spring water to cool before tasting it for myself.

dialogues.speaker: Manaia
dialogues.text: But Monsieur Neuvillette... Why would anyone want to taste hot spring water at all?

dialogues.speaker: Manaia
dialogues.text: Mhm! Not only is the water here too hot, it's also bad for your stomach.
